integrity: Proof uses previously published atomic-change and chain-graph theorems, with explicit witnesses for each nonpendant edge. Finite tests are corroboration, not a substitute for the infinite proof. Bibliographic completeness and external independent audit are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Strict half graphs of order n>=3 and one deleted edge only. The case n=2 is explicitly exceptional. No claim is made for arbitrary Ferrers graphs or simultaneous deletions.
title: Sharp Grundy-domination sensitivity of half graphs under every edge deletion
